subject: Reseller addendum: pass-through / billing flow clarification
messages:
From: Natalie Gomez <natalie.gomez@cloudresale.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: LegalOps <legalops@cloudresale.com>
Date: Wed, 9 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Reseller addendum redlines (pass-through concerns)

Hi Karthik,

Attached are our proposed redlines to the reseller addendum and the order form. We appreciate the quick turnaround. There are three principal items we need clarified/changed before we can proceed with our marketplace onboarding team: 

1) Fee pass-through: We cannot accept joint liability for marketplace fees. We need Redwood to acknowledge that the marketplace charges are being passed through and that CloudResale will be invoiced via the marketplace or a designated reseller flow.

2) Tax and chargebacks: We requested a tax-backstop carveout in section 5.2 — your redline currently pushes that to CloudResale. For compliance reasons we need Redwood to either (a) accept tax gross-up for charges billed via marketplace, or (b) provide a written flow that ensures CloudResale is not exposed to retrospective tax assessments.

3) Billing reconciliation timing & crediting: The marketplace has a 60-day reconciliation window. We need clear language on how refunds, chargebacks, and usage adjustments will be handled (who issues credits to end-customers vs. reseller).

We attach a marked copy. Can we get a brief call tomorrow to align legal + ops? If not, please note any non-starters and we’ll attempt a solution on our end.

Attachments: CloudResale_Redlines_20261209.docx (redline), RFQ_CloudResale_FeeSchedule.pdf

Thanks,
Natalie
Head of Partnerships — CloudResale Inc.

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: Natalie Gomez <natalie.gomez@cloudresale.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 9 Dec 2026 11:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Reseller addendum redlines (pass-through concerns)

Thanks Natalie — received and thanks for the clear flags. I’ve looped in Marissa (corporate & commercial) and Ben (billing ops) so we can triage the three items you called out.

Quick thoughts before a sync:
- Fee pass-through: we are comfortable stating that marketplace fees are "passed through" and will be reflected on the invoice flow, but we need to confirm the invoicing path (marketplace invoice to CloudResale vs Redwood invoicing CloudResale and paying marketplace fees). Ben — can you confirm whether CloudResale will receive invoices directly from the marketplace in your experience, or whether Redwood will need to act as the invoicing intermediary here?
- Tax/backstop: this one is sensitive. Marissa, see Natalie’s suggested placement in 5.2 — if Redwood accepts gross-up we will need to reflect a limited carveout and include a cap or a remediation process (we typically propose a 12-month lookback with mutual cooperation).
- Reconciliations: happy to accept a 60-day reconciliation window, but we need a defined crediting flow (who credits end-customers, who credits reseller). Ben, pls advise operations impact.

Natalie — can you do a 30-minute call Thu 10 Dec 10:00–10:30 PT? If not, propose a time. We’ll have a redline to push back with before the call.

— Karthik
Senior Manager, Channel Sales
Redwood Inference

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 08:52:00 -0800
Subject: Internal: proposed edits for CloudResale redlines

Karthik / Ben — digesting Natalie’s redlines. Below are proposed positions we should take on the call and a suggested clean replacement for the problematic sections. I’ll be on the call with legal counsel.

1) Fee pass-through (section 3.1):
Suggested language: "Marketplace fees that are assessed by a third-party marketplace ("Marketplace Fees") shall be passed through to Reseller when Reseller is billed directly by the Marketplace. If Redwood invoices Reseller directly, Redwood shall reflect Marketplace Fees as a separate line item and reimburse same to the Marketplace; Redwood shall provide Reseller with supporting fee schedules upon request."
Rationale: keeps the commercial outcome neutral — Reseller won’t bear undisclosed fees, and Redwood remains accountable if we are the invoicing intermediary.

2) Tax/backstop (section 5.2):
Suggested language: "Except as expressly provided herein, each party shall be responsible for taxes imposed on it. For taxes assessed on gross receipts or similar charges attributable to Marketplace transactions, Redwood agrees to cooperate to the extent necessary to mitigate retrospective assessments and, where Redwood acted as the invoicing party, Redwood shall indemnify Reseller for taxes resulting from Redwood’s failure to collect or remit applicable taxes, subject to a 12‑month lookback and cap equal to fees collected from the Reseller for the affected transactions."
Rationale: limits long-tail exposure with a timebound remediation cap.

3) Reconciliation & credits (section 6.3):
Suggested process bullet points for the addendum:
- Marketplace provides a provisional invoice to Reseller and Redwood within 30 days of the billing period close.
- Final reconciliation occurs within 60 days; adjustments are communicated to both parties.
- If Marketplace issues credits to end-customers, Redwood will coordinate issuance of corresponding credits to Reseller within 30 days of notification.

Ben — operationally, can Redwood commit to a 30‑day internal window to issue credits to resellers after marketplace finalization? If not, propose the SLA and exceptions.

I’ll prepare a redline with the above language and upload prior to the call. Also note: we should avoid open-ended indemnities. Keep it narrowly tied to invoicing responsibility.

Marissa Cole
Senior Counsel, Commercial Contracts
Redwood Inference

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: Natalie Gomez <natalie.gomez@cloudresale.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 11 Dec 2026 15:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Reseller addendum redlines (pass-through concerns)

Natalie — thanks for the call earlier. Confirming agreed points and next steps so we’re aligned: 

Summary of agreements:
- Fee pass-through: Redwood will accept pass-through mechanics. If CloudResale is billed directly by the marketplace, those Marketplace Fees will be considered passed through and Redwood will not re-bill. If Redwood is the invoicing intermediary, Redwood will show Marketplace Fees as a separate line item and Redwood will be responsible for remitting the fees to the marketplace.
- Tax/backstop: Redwood can accept a limited indemnity for taxes tied to Redwood’s invoicing errors, subject to a 12‑month lookback and cap equal to the fees collected for the impacted transactions. Marissa’s language will be used in the redline.
- Reconciliations & credits: Parties agreed to a 60-day final reconciliation window. Redwood will aim to issue corresponding credits to Reseller within 30 days of notification from the marketplace, subject to normal billing exceptions.

Next steps / deliverables:
- I’ve attached our redline of the addendum (attached: Redwood_Redline_20261211.docx). Please review and confirm any final non-starters by EOD Monday 14 Dec.
- If the redline looks acceptable, we’ll send an Order Form for signature via DocuSign and include the agreed fee schedule. DocuSign link will be provided (see related link).

Attachments: Redwood_Redline_20261211.docx

If anything above is missing or misstated, flag immediately and we’ll correct. Otherwise we’ll proceed with the orderform issuance early next week.

Best,
